payload.acceptance_criteria: When an agent is named in --agents, setup shall install it with its vendor script (Copilot on Windows: npm), and set CODEX_NON_INTERACTIVE=1 in unattended mode. When an agent is not named, setup shall neither install nor update it.
payload.description:
## Trigger

When I opt into coding agents with --agents, I want each agent installed by the method its vendor puts first, and I want setup to leave every agent I did not name alone, so I can trust that agents stay opt-in.

Research on 2026-10-13 from the vendor pages: Claude Code recommends its native script; Codex lists its installer script first (npm is also); the Copilot product page shows gh.io/copilot-install first, and that script calls winget on MINGW/MSYS, so Windows uses npm. Before this change --update updated every present agent, named or not.
payload.requirements: Tests cover the scripts, the unattended flag and the opt-in rule; docs name the method per platform.
payload.title: Install each coding agent the way its vendor recommends, and only when named
